entities.name: UAC-0041
entities.gloss: A threat actor tracked by CERT-UA associated with widespread credential theft and malware distribution campaigns.

entities.name: RelicRace
entities.gloss: A .NET downloader malware designed to fetch, decode, and execute secondary payloads in memory.

entities.name: RelicSource
entities.gloss: A .NET installer and loader malware that decrypts and executes embedded payloads.

entities.name: Formbook
entities.gloss: An infostealer malware family designed to harvest credentials, keystrokes, and sensitive information from infected systems.

entities.name: Snake Keylogger
entities.gloss: A keylogger and infostealer malware family capable of capturing user keystrokes and system credentials.

entities.name: OneDrive
entities.gloss: A cloud storage and file synchronization service developed by Microsoft.

entities.name: Telegram
entities.gloss: A cloud-based instant messaging service and application.

entities.name: Остаточний платіж.tgz
entities.gloss: A malicious archive file attached to phishing emails to deliver malware.

entities.name: Остаточний платіж.tar
entities.gloss: An archive file used in the malware delivery chain.

entities.name: Остаточний платіж.exe
entities.gloss: An executable file containing the RelicRace downloader malware.

entities.name: Mvbsbaoqmoffjfvhqvkpaia.dll
entities.gloss: A dynamic link library file associated with the RelicSource malware.

entities.name: formbook.exe
entities.gloss: An executable payload delivering the Formbook malware.

entities.name: clientes@taximadridclass.com
entities.gloss: An email address used as an indicator of compromise in the phishing campaign.

entities.name: info@kivanclardokum.com.tr

entities.name: barbacoalosmartinez.com
